key_insight: A Transformer surrogate can explain an EHR foundation model at the token level by approximating its predictions and highlighting the most influential patient-history tokens.
clinical_relevance: The token-level explanations showed good alignment with clinically validated features, which may improve trust and interpretability for prediction support in EHR-based AI.
method: Trained a Transformer-based surrogate on input-output pairs from the FEMR.
Used the surrogate to identify the most influential tokens in patient trajectories.
Introduced a clinical alignment metric to compare key tokens with validated clinical features.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation across two prediction tasks, with the surrogate closely approximating FEMR predictions and showing strong clinical alignment.
watch_item: Surrogate explanations may reflect approximation quality rather than the FEMR’s true internal reasoning, so clinical use should be cautious.
paper_title: X-FEMR: A Token-level Explainable Approach for Electronic Health Records Foundation Models using Transformer-based Models
